newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies tumble sharply on fund sell stops.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies tumble sharply on fund sell stops.

text.p: CME pork belly futures tumbled for sharp losses as local pressure and profit taking took prices down into fund sell stops, traders said.
February fell as much as 2.700 cents a lb before recovering to trade 1.900 lower at 77.300 cents. At 0937 CST other months stood 2.175 to 1.850 cents lower.

Carryover demand was lacking from Thursday's gains as the market appeared overbought. A larger-than-expected hog slaughter Thursday also weighed on the market and the resulting setback touched off the sell stops, traders said.
